nusmp.ui.crest.title: Alert crest
nusmp.ui.crest.test_text: This is where Great Sage will tell you what it has recorded.
nusmp.ui.crest.hint: Drag the crest where you want it. Arrow keys nudge it (Shift = 8). Enter saves, Esc cancels.
